text.tspan: # Example: minimal session — start, two turns, one tool, end
"wilson 은 hexa-native AI coding agent — minimal core + plugin-first."
# Example: multi-tool causal chain — assistant fans out 3 tools,
# aggregates results, replies. Shows multi-id `<- t001, t002, t003`
"list the hexa files under core/ and count them"
"I'll glob for core/*.hexa, count lines in each"
"7 .hexa files under core/, 8420 lines total; entry = core/main.hexa"
# Example: governance deny — assistant proposes a dangerous write,
# governance blocks before exec. Shows `!!` abort edge +
"Blocked — /etc/passwd writes are not allowed under the default governance profile. Want me to draft the change as a patch instead?"
# Example: resume + replay — `@S resume == s001` continuation edge.
# Continuation is byte-canonical: the resumed tape is a strict
# suffix of the original file (same path, O_APPEND reopen).
# tape_replay populates the agent loop's history from the prior tape:
# No new @U/@A entries are emitted at resume — they already exist.
# ── 새 턴 (new turn on top of resumed history) ──────────
"그 hexa 파일들 중 가장 큰 거?"
"이전 컨텍스트 — 7개 core/*.hexa 파일을 봤었지. core/main.hexa 가 가장 큼 (3122 bytes)."
# ── 빌드별 버전 스탬프 (hexa build 자동 발행) ─────────────────
# The `## Log` section of HARNESS.md is auto-rendered from this tape
# Append via git pre-commit hook (path→domain map) or manually.
text = "wilson -p / interactive TUI claims input loop"
# ── 변경 이력 (commit-driven via git pre-commit hook) ─────────
"ToolResult out-of-band handoff — agent loop returns {assistant, tool_results}"
"bidi-stdio primitive unlocks real MCP JSON-RPC client"
"Shift+Enter / Alt+Enter multi-line input (deferred to next branch)"
# Wilson's "minimal viable agent" meta-domain — held iff all five
# constituent conditions plus the joint M1 are evidenced in the tape.
text = "wilson -p / interactive TUI claims input loop"
text = "at least one provider plugin registered"
text = "host_run_turn(messages, tools, opts) returns Message + ToolResult"
"all constituent conditions still hold — meta-domain stays live"
